ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/TA444 fake-recruiter ISO/LNK chain spawning Windows scripting hosts from compressed-archive containers
ucs.description: Hunts the Bluenoroff/Sapphire Sleet social-engineering chain where targets in finance/crypto verticals receive ISO, VHD, or ZIP containers (delivered via fake LinkedIn/recruiter lures) that mount and execute LNK files invoking wscript.exe, cscript.exe, mshta.exe, or rundll32.exe to stage second-stage loaders. This combination of container-based delivery + LNK proxy + scripting host is a signature TA444/APT38 tradecraft chain (T1204.002 + T1218.001/.005/.011 + T1059.005/.007).
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_process values(Processes.process_hash) as process_hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe","Bandizip.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") AND (Processes.process LIKE "%.iso%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.vhd%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.lnk%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\Downloads\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%Recruit%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%JobDescription%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%Interview%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%Skills%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%Compensation%") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id Processes.parent_process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | where firstTime > relative_time(now(), "-7d@d")
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","bandizip.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".iso",".vhd",".lnk",@"\AppData\Local\Temp\",@"\Downloads\","Recruit","JobDescription","Interview","Skills","Compensation","Coinbase","Crypto")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildName  = tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1])
| where ParentName in~ ("explorer.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","bandizip.exe")
| where ChildName  in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (".iso",".vhd",".lnk",@"\AppData\Local\Temp\",@"\Downloads\","Recruit","JobDescription","Interview","Skills","Compensation","Coinbase","Crypto")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff/TA444 ISO-LNK Recruiter Lure Spawning Scripting Host
id: 3d4f7c4a-9e2f-4f1c-9b1e-bnoroff-iso-lnk
status: experimental
description: Detects Bluenoroff/Sapphire Sleet fake-recruiter chain where an archive/ISO-mount parent launches wscript/cscript/mshta/rundll32 referencing recruiter-themed paths.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1059.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\WinRAR.exe'
      - '\Bandizip.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  selection_lure:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.iso'
      - '.vhd'
      - '.lnk'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - 'Recruit'
      - 'JobDescription'
      - 'Interview'
      - 'Skills'
      - 'Compensation'
      - 'Coinbase'
      - 'Crypto'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_lure
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate recruiter document workflows using scripting hosts (rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\7zfm.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\winrar.exe OR *\Bandizip.exe OR *\bandizip.exe) @Image:(*\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*.iso* OR *.ISO* OR *.vhd* OR *.VHD* OR *.lnk* OR *.LNK* OR *Recruit* OR *recruit* OR *JobDescription* OR *Interview* OR *Coinbase* OR *Crypto*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(explorer|7zfm|winrar|bandizip)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\.iso|\\.vhd|\\.lnk|\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Downloads\\\\|Recruit|JobDescription|Interview|Skills|Compensation|Coinbase|Crypto)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])])

_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/APT38 SnatchCrypto persistence via wscript Run-key autostart writing to AppData/Roaming
ucs.description: Hunts the post-execution persistence step Bluenoroff uses in SnatchCrypto/AppleJeus-style intrusions: a script-host (wscript/cscript) or rundll32 process writes a Run/RunOnce registry value pointing at a payload dropped under %AppData%\Roaming or %LocalAppData%\Temp. This T1547.001 + T1059.005 + T1105 sequence is the SnatchCrypto / TraderTraitor / DangerousPassword post-compromise fingerprint observed across crypto-exchange compromises attributed to G0098.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_name) as value_name values(Registry.registry_value_data) as value_data values(Registry.process_name) as process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where (Registry.registry_path="*\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*") AND Registry.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe") AND (Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%AppData\\Roaming%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%AppData\\Local\\Temp%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%.vbs%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%.js%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%.dll%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%rundll32%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%regsvr32%") by Registry.dest Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | where firstTime > relative_time(now(), "-7d@d")
ucs.kql:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe")
| where RegistryValueData has_any (@"AppData\Roaming", @"AppData\Local\Temp", ".vbs", ".js", ".dll", "rundll32", "regsvr32")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated","set")
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce")
| extend ActorBin = tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ActorBin in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe")
| where RegistryValueData has_any (@"AppData\Roaming", @"AppData\Local\Temp", ".vbs", ".js", ".dll", "rundll32", "regsvr32")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, RegistryKey, RegistryValue, RegistryValueData
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Bluenoroff/APT38 Script-Host Run-Key Persistence to AppData
id: 7a2b1e5d-c5d4-4f8b-8b91-bnoroff-runkey-appdata
status: experimental
description: Detects Bluenoroff/SnatchCrypto persistence where wscript/cscript/rundll32/regsvr32/mshta writes a Run or RunOnce registry value pointing at a payload under AppData.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-108a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1547.001
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.t1218.011
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\'
      - '\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\'
  selection_actor:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  selection_payload:
    Details|contains:
      - 'AppData\Roaming'
      - 'AppData\Local\Temp'
      - '.vbs'
      - '.js'
      - '.dll'
      - 'rundll32'
      - 'regsvr32'
  condition: selection_key and selection_actor and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - Software installers writing autostart entries (rare from script hosts)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\* OR *\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\* OR *\microsoft\windows\currentversion\run\* OR *\microsoft\windows\currentversion\runonce\*) @Image:(*\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe) @Details:(*AppData\Roaming* OR *AppData\Local\Temp* OR *.vbs* OR *.js* OR *.dll* OR *rundll32* OR *regsvr32*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate regex("(?i)\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run(Once)?\\\\", field=RegObjectName)
| ContextImageFileName=/(wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|powershell)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(AppData\\\\Roaming|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|\\.vbs|\\.js|\\.dll|rundll32|regsvr32)", field=RegStringValue)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue], function=[count(), min(@timestamp)])
